rows.heading: Encashment of Earned Leave
rows.quote_snippet: 4.2 Encashment Calculation Formula: The cash equivalent of leave salary for encashment shall be calculated strictly as: Cash Amount = [(Basic Pay on date of retirement + IDA applicable) / 30] × Number of Unutilized EL Days (up to max 300). No house rent allowance (HRA), cafeteria perks, or performance related pay (PRP) shall be included in the encashment calculation.

rows.heading: Encashment of Earned Leave
rows.quote_snippet: 4.3 Running Encashment during Service: An employee may encash up to 30 days EL once in a calendar year, provided a minimum balance of 30 days EL is retained in their leave account after such encashment.
